title: bouteloua tenuis var. humilis
intro: Bouteloua tenuis var. humilis, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Great Plains region of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Blue Grama Grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the therapeutic actions of Blue Grama Grass include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing.
